annotation.title_clean: Política para la Transformación Digital en Cuba (incl. Estrategia de Desarrollo de la Inteligencia Artificial)
annotation.title_en: Policy for Digital Transformation in Cuba (incl. Artificial Intelligence Development Strategy)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Gobierno de Cuba (Ministerio de Comunicaciones, MINCOM)
annotation.summary_en: Cuba's May 2024 Digital Transformation Policy and AI Development Strategy. It designates the Ministry of Communications as lead body, creates a government programme and permanent secretariat, sets eight strategic axes, and includes an AI strategy promoting ethical, responsible use, research, international cooperation and public awareness. No robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: MINCOM designated lead entity for digital transformation, reporting annually to the Council of Ministers
Creates a Government Programme and Permanent Secretariat for Digital Transformation with eight strategic axes
Aligns the policy with Marxist, Martían and Fidelist visions and national sovereignty and security
AI strategy promotes ethical, responsible AI use, research, international cooperation and training
Communication axis aims to reduce AI usage gaps by age, gender, residence and occupation
